text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. Sounds of 
Earth extended an invitation to me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—Now, are your ears and heart ready? My 
amore!”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us enjoy it together! The 
ultimate armonia! The "sound" of the 
Earth!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Earth, geological strata... A grazioso 
musical score! A supreme melodia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, relax. Lend your ears to this legato 
'sound'!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's a gentle melody. Flowing smoothly, 
smoothly along, just like a river...
choice_data_list: Smooth and flowing, like a river...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gaze at the strata while turning those 
words over in my mind. Looking at this 
earth that has built up over tens of 
thousands of years—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A grand current, like a mighty river of 
history. I felt like I could sense it."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm certainly pushing boundaries by 
expanding my race research all the way 
into geological strata, but still...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You guys are quite the quirky bunch 
yourselves...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a straight horizon— What a grandioso 
"sound" that is!

—Ehh~!? Amazing, amazing♡ You can hear 
outside noises from in here?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! ♡ I wanna be able to hear 
the "sounds" of a celebrity town too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Even Vivlos should be able to hear 
it. Let's harmonize with the 'sound' using 
our passionate anima!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Listen—everyone on Earth is a solisti. Yet 
if you tune in, they're in perfect sync! 
Just like...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Observing the passing people and objects 
just like geological strata... I tuned my 
ears to the "sounds." And then—
choice_data_list:
All kinds of "sounds" coming together, 
like an orchestra.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! An orchestra bursting with unique 
colors! The greatest, supreme session!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?? I don't get it at all. But—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A different view in a world known only to 
the two of us... That's so romantic~♡

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, benissimo...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Earth happily continued to 
listen to the planet overflowing with 
"sound."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
We got to enjoy a truly brillante day, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
An ensemble with the Earth that truly 
satisfies a musicista... It was utterly 
sublime!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
—Step right up, step right up! Hey little 
lady, how about some takoyaki?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
The size is massive! The calories are 
worth three meals! It's none other 
than—the "Earth Takoyaki"!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ......Earth, takoyaki...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth, who has spent her life 
contemplating the great "sound." Even if 
they share the name "Earth," takoyaki 
might be a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fantastico!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It might be right before dinner, 
but it's merely a light snack... Please 
overlook it!
choice_data_list: Were you drawn to that as well!?
Were you drawn to that too!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Certo! Even a takoyaki is a miniature 
globe! An Earth!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Flour, boiled octopus, green onions, 
pickled ginger... An armonia of diversity!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Crispy on the outside, gooey on the 
inside... Their perfect harmony forms an 
l'orchestra playing a fantastico melodia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us partake in this joy! A 
full three meals' worth of calories... The 
"Earth Takoyaki"!!
choice_data_list: C-Can we really finish all this!?
Then... I'll take on the challenge too!
Then... I'll take on the challenge too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us partake in this joy! A 
full three meals' worth of calories... The 
"Earth Takoyaki"!!
choice_data_list: C-Can we really finish all this!?
Then... I'll take on the challenge too!
Then... I'll take on the challenge too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I see. So it's too big for you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! It's too early to give up, 
customer!"

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text:
The giant 'Earth Takoyaki' also comes in 
smaller sizes!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Man
text_block_list.text: I call it, 'Miniature Earth Takoyaki'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I got sweet-talked by that 
smooth-talking vendor and ended up eating 
ordinary takoyaki.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Magnificent! As expected of my direttore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Magnificent! As expected of my direttrice!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us savor the wonders of Earth 
together! —In perfect armonia with "Earth 
Takoyaki"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, with Earth watching over me, I 
indulged in some giant takoyaki until I 
was completely full!
